messages:
jordan: FYI - working a vuln triage for CVE-2026-2110, need a short, timeboxed log snapshot from the auth pipeline to reproduce. Target window: 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z -> 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z. Who can approve a 4h export with masked PII?
sasha: tag me. quick q — will this contain email and full IPs? if so we must do masking/tokenization + KMS unwrap controls.
jordan: yes there are user_ids and emails in some events. proposed approach: masked export (user_id -> sha256, email redacted, ip -> /24 mask), TTL for unwrap 4h, export stored encrypted in s3 with CMK alias/al_vuln_snap. retention: snapshot deleted after 7 days.
mike: i can run the siem snapshot job once RBAC + grants exist. what exact policy do you need?
security-bot: runbook checklist: 1) ticket created 2) infra PR for temp role 3) CMK grant with timeboxed key policy 4) auditor notify 5) deletion lifecycle configured 6) oncall assigned. Missing items will block export.
jordan: opened ticket SEC-2453. Requesting a temporary role "vuln-triage-analyst" with minimal privileges: ["siem:search:read","siem:export:masked"] duration 4h. Auditor: @pranav. KMS unwrap only by oncall + role holders.
pranav: i can approve but need the exact SIEM query, concrete scrub rules, and confirmation that no raw PII will be written to the snapshot. Also require a per-export salt for hashing stored in the ticket.
jordan: query (approx):
```
auth.events
| where service=="auth"
| where event in ("login_failed","password_reset","login_success")
| where timestamp >= "2026-03-22T01:00:00Z" and timestamp <= "2026-03-22T03:00:00Z"
```
Scrub rules: user_id -> sha256(user_id + SALT), email -> "[redacted]", ip -> mask_last_octet (e.g., 10.1.2.0/24), remove auth_token fields. Destination: s3://redwood-exports/SEC-2453/ encrypted with CMK alias/al_vuln_snap. retention: snapshot lifecycle delete after 7 days. KMS unwrap window (allow decrypt) = 4h after export starts.
oncall-liz: i'll be on rotation during the window, add me to the grant list for unwrap. add justification in the ticket with steps i should run.
mike: sample command i'll use once role exists and ticket is green:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://siem.internal/api/v1/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\n    "query": "<above query>",\n    "scrub_rules": [\n      {"field":"user_id","action":"sha256+salt","salt_ticket":"SEC-2453"},\n      {"field":"email","action":"redact"},\n      {"field":"ip","action":"mask_last_octet"}\n    ],\n    "s3_destination":"s3://redwood-exports/SEC-2453/",\n    "encryption_kms_alias":"alias/al_vuln_snap"\n  }'\n```
sasha: we'll need an infra PR to add the role and a lambda that enforces deletion after 7d (or rely on S3 lifecycle). i'll prep the PR and include reviewers @sre @seceng. also add a step to rotate the per-export salt after deletion.
security-bot: checklist status update: ticket SEC-2453 created, pending infra PR, pending KMS grant change, auditor notification queued. please attach infra PR link in ticket to auto-run gating checks.
pranav: approved in principle. requirements: 1) store SALT in ticket vault (no secrets in PR), 2) log audit event for grant and unwrap with reason field, 3) require MFA for oncall when performing unwrap.
jordan: ack. i'll add SALT to SEC-2453 ticket vault and update the justification. starting infra PR now.
sasha: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2773 - adds vuln-triage-analyst role, scoped policy, and s3 lifecycle lambda. reviewers: @sre @seceng.
oncall-liz: once PR merges, ping me. i'll perform unwrap steps and watch the export start. i'll also capture the unwrap audit event.
mike: waiting on role to merge—ETA?
sasha: merging after one small comment; should be <20m.
security-bot: infra PR merged by sasha. KMS request filed as KMS-1245. awaiting KMS-ops approval.
pranav: KMS-ops approval noted, auditor subscribed. Approving final export once KMS grant appears in KMS-1245. make sure the ticket has the SALT value.
jordan: SALT added to SEC-2453 vault (reference vault://sec/SEC-2453/salt). preparing to kick export after KMS approval.
security-bot: export job created record: id=9876, snapshot path s3://redwood-exports/SEC-2453/9876.json.enc. unwrap window 4h from 2026-03-22T01:05:00Z.
jordan: snapshot job started and completed. shared access to vuln-triage-analyst principals only. KMS unwrap window closed. snapshot scheduled for deletion in 7 days. I'll update the ticket with pointers for reproducing.
pranav: confirmed audit events look good: grant, decrypt, and delete events present. closing approval.
security-bot: export SEC-2453 marked completed and retention anchor set.
jordan: thanks all — triage team has what they need. follow-ups: post-mortem note in ticket with lessons and consider adding a template for future vuln triage exports.
